Watch this beautiful moment and remember what truly binds us: unconditional love. A child’s hug reminding Mom she’s not alone—that pure, healing embrace. This is the grace we all need more of.

Video

I love this. What a gift. There is such power in feeling seen, connected, acknowledged. We need more of that, not just from the famous but from all of us.

Video

This is heartbreaking and unconscionable. After weeks in family detention, toddler Amalia was rushed to a hospital with critically low oxygen levels. She fought for her life in intensive care—under ICE watch—only to be sent back to the very Dilley center where she nearly died, amid widespread respiratory illnesses among children.

This cruelty has no place in America.

Video

Farmers and truckers are being pushed to the brink - skyrocketing diesel costs, endless economic ripples from this unjust war.

Video

Our brave service members are doing their jobs, and facing life and death situations every day. Congressional Republicans should be doing their job, fulfilling their constitutional responsibility and checking this out of control president. 

I will continue to fight with every tool and power we have in the Senate to stop this reckless war

Video

The DOJ indicted the Southern Poverty Law Center, an organization that has spent more than half a century fighting the Klan, tracking hate, and defending civil rights.

Let's be clear about what's happening. This administration is using the full weight of federal prosecution to target an organization whose mission is rooting out violent extremism. 

This is part and parcel of Trump's assault on free speech, on nonprofits, and on anyone who dares to disagree with him. First it was lawfare against

If you want to go far, go together. This is what America looks like at its best: not racing alone, but lifting each other up. Compassion over competition. Love in action. 

We are better when we run as one.

Video

There is extraordinary power in kindness. It impacts the recipient; inspires the witness; and transforms the giver into a force for good - someone who doesn’t just hope for a better world, but helps create it.

Video

Trump is turning the IRS into his own personal checking account — suing the government, cutting deals with himself, and cashing checks while the American people foot the bill.

This is a blatant conflict of interest that ignores the rule of law and betrays the public trust.

Video

Millions of Americans are staring down skyrocketing health care costs as subsidies expire. 

Families shouldn't have to choose between medicine and rent, between childcare and healthcare. 

We must fight for affordable care for ALL.

Video

ICE is reckless and out of control.

A 27-year Army veteran with three tours in Afghanistan — Sgt. 1st Class Jose Serrano — watched ICE agents arrest his wife during a routine immigration appointment, even after they showed military IDs.

This cruelty must stop. We will not fund an agency that terrorizes the families of those who served our nation.

Video

We are living in a time of despair, fear, and hurt, those emotions are real and understandable. 
But we cannot wait for others to bring us hope. 
Hope is the active conviction that despair won't have the last word. 
Don't wait for anyone else. 
We are each other’s hope. 
We are the heroes we’ve been looking for.

Video

Morning Mood:
Defiant dancing.
Joy contagious.
Energy unstoppable.

One person steps in…
and suddenly a room steps up.

Yes, there’s a lot going wrong in the world.
But don’t underestimate the quiet power of showing up with fire 🔥 .

Ignite the energy.
Break the tension.
Be the spark.
Lead the charge. 

Because joy isn’t just a feeling
it’s resistance. 
It's defiance.
It's a force.

Video

Grateful for the courage of Principal Kirk Moore in Oklahoma—running toward danger, tackling a gunman to shield his students.

But let’s be clear: this kind of bravery should never be required of our educators or our children.
Our kids’ leading killer is gun violence.

We cannot just praise courage—we must match it with action, and stand up to stop these tragedies.

Video

This is the kind of truth-telling we need right now.

Video

Our political and economic system is failing everyday Americans.

Crushing healthcare costs.  
Unaffordable housing.  
Broken immigration 
Reckless foreign wars
And leadership that sows division instead of unity.

It’s time for a New Deal rooted in love over hate.

Video

I had an inspiring visit today to the Jack & Sheryl Morris Cancer Center in New Brunswick—New Jersey’s only free-standing cancer hospital. 

I was deeply moved by the extraordinary care, the dedication of the teams at RWJBarnabas Health and Rutgers Cancer Institute, and the hope they’re bringing to families facing cancer.

This is profoundly disturbing. Top military aides—sworn to defend the Constitution—had to keep Trump out of the command room due to his erratic behavior.

The man leading an illegal, reckless war in Iran cannot even be trusted by his own military advisors.

Video

Courage 
Grace 
Service and Sacrifice 

We are the heroes the world needs more of.
